newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's EdF says to pay Spain's REE 30 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: France's EdF says to pay Spain's REE 30 bln ptas.

text.p: France's Electricite de France (EdF) utility said on Tuesday it will pay Red Electrica de Espana (REE) total compensation of 30 billion pesetas to settle a breach of contract case.
An EdF official denied an earlier statement by REE that said the French utility would pay 300 billion pesetas to settle the matter.
"We deny that we will pay 300 billion pesetas," the official said. "We will pay 30 billion pesetas, some in cash and some in the framework of contractual readjustments."

REE, which monitors Spain's high-tension electrical network, said the payment was being made for the breach of a contract signed in 1990 and the compensation money would be passed on to customers in the form of lower electrical rates.

In the 1990 contract, EdF agreed to connect the French electrical network to the Spanish network and provide 1,000 megawatts of electricity a year. France later suspended the plan citing environmental concerns.
